description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit a research lab facility record with the research lab accreditation, work, safety and inspection records it answers to: the reading moment; the facility with its reference, name, the responsible director or technical manager it names, the services and methods it claims and the rooms, areas and capabilities it lists in service; each accreditation or registration with its id, reference (the certificate number), accreditor or registering body, the scope as issued, the director or technical manager it names and the moments issued and expiring; each work entry the laboratory’s other records show with its id, reference, the service performed and the moment performed; each safety or inspection entry with its id, reference, the room, area or capability, its state (in service, restricted or closed) and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the facility record and the records behind it, each service the facility record claims against the scope of a current accreditation, the director or technical manager it names against each accreditation record, each work entry against an accreditation in force on its date, and each area it lists in service against its latest safety or inspection entry, and counts them, and names divergent research lab facility records: a service no current accredited scope covers, a director or technical manager named in one record and absent in the other, work recorded while no accreditation covering it was in force, and an area listed in service that the safety or inspection records close or restrict; then an accreditation entry missing its accreditor, issue date or expiry date and a service claimed twice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No accreditation record beside claimed services, no work entries beside accreditations or no safety and inspection entries beside listed areas leaves those points unverified. Certificates, work entries and areas match by letters and digits, so CERT-4471 and CERT 4471 are one certificate, services and scope entries by their words with plurals folded, directors by name past a title, dates by the day. This reads the laboratory’s master record of the facility as operations paper only; no study record, subject record or result value is an input. Verdict researchlab_facility_record_divergent, researchlab_facility_record_partial, researchlab_facility_record_unverified or researchlab_facility_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-facility-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.
